entries.equivalence_relation: Two local references are equivalent when they induce the same admissibility-preserving continuation class under the active O=(L,Q) operator family.
entries.degeneracy_regions: Regions where multiple O candidates minimize relational mismatch within tolerance and therefore induce set-valued -(i).
entries.transition_boundaries: Boundaries where the minimizing O* changes, bifurcates, or becomes set-valued.

rules.name: minimizer_switching_rule_v1
rules.statement: A transition between O* minimizers is admissible only if it preserves Ref(.) equivalence or passes through a declared degeneracy boundary, residue-mediated recoupling event, or admissibility-window change.
